verdicts.question: What are the trust boundaries crossed during install, update, repair, rollback and uninstall, and for each boundary which STRIDE category has no mitigating control?
verdicts.short_answer: Seven trust boundaries, 42 STRIDE cells. 21 unmitigated, 8 partial, 2 mitigated, 11 n/a. The install path has no publisher authentication, no expansion bound, no containment on version_dir, and uninstall deletes lr/live_rel without safe_join. The controls that held under executed bypass are packager.unpack/safe_join (zip-slip) and deploy-side safe_join.

per_target.TB7: R unmitigated; I partial; T/S/D/E n/a
